contracts: Read-only thread/session never resumes unloaded work. Settings refresh on native thread/settings/updated, closed and status notifications.

Separate future thread settings and current-turn settings. Current turn identity is pinned; changing the active turn discards unsubmitted selections rather than retargeting them. targetUnavailable is explicit.

Only selected fields are sent. Omission preserves existing fields; explicit serviceTier:null clears the override. Model efforts/tiers and allowed permission profiles are chosen from bounded current catalogs. Profile paging preserves opaque cursors and project ID scope.
Provider capability booleans are displayed as provider reports, not account/model guarantees.
Native replies and original durable receipts are distinguished; unknown does not replay and receipt acceptance alone does not claim current-turn settings applied.
